text:
alex: Quick heads-up — planning deploy of v2.4.1 (model routing + cache changes) Wed 2026-05-06 10:00 PT. Owner: tyler. Need CS/marketing ok, smoke-checks, rollback readiness. Ping @support_lead @pm_sam.
maria: Thanks. We need final release notes and customer impact summary by EOD Tue. Any breaking changes? Any required CS scripts?
tyler: No breaking changes. Changes: routing fallback tweak + cache TTL bump. Canary at 5% for 20m, then 50% for 30m if healthy, then full. Rollback: flip routing flag -> old variant, flush caches. I'll run the deploy and own rollback.
tyler: Smoke checks (quick):
```
# can run from CI bastion
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-2","prompt":"smoke"}' | jq '.status'
curl -sS https://api.redwood.example/health | jq '.up'
```
jen: Support will prepare KB + canned responses. Can you list expected errors/timeouts so we can triage?
tyler: Expect transient quota errors on dedicated pools if warmup slow. Watch 429 spikes and 'kv-cache-miss' logs. I'll add alerts.
support_lead: We'll create KB draft and run script on Wed morning with staging data. Add #support-release channel?
pm_sam: Marketing needs 48h to schedule banner+email. Want final feature blurb + 2 screenshots by Tue noon. Also confirm no customer-visible version bump in API.
maria: Confirmed — no API contract changes. Only routing behavior and perf improvements. I'll draft release notes and share PR in #docs.
deploy-bot: pipeline queued by tyler for v2.4.1; build 882 started.
tyler: I'll post the exact rollback command in this thread 30m before deploy. Also I'll be on pager for the window. Contact: me, alex, jen.
alex: Perfect. If CS/marketing thumbs-up, proceed. :thumbsup:
jen: Thumbs up from support. KB will be ready Wed 8:00 PT.
pm_sam: Marketing ok — schedule banner for Wed 12:00 PT. We'll wait for confirmation after canary.
alex: Great — final checklist:
- [ ] Release notes PR merged (maria)
- [ ] KB + canned responses (jen)
- [ ] Marketing assets (pm_sam)
- [ ] Canary monitoring (tyler)
- [ ] Rollback command posted (tyler)

alex: If anything changes ping here. Thanks all.
